title: 实验室安全第一课
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/12_Module 1 — Introduction to Laboratory Safety.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/12_Module 1 — Introduction to Laboratory Safety/src.py

points.K3: 每次实验押上的四样东西
points.K5: 制度定目标，实验室定做法
points.K6: 计划要活，负责人要在岗
points.K7: 没有规定，也不能无视危险
points.K8: 安全和质量在实验台交汇
points.K12: 安全改动也是实验变更
points.S2: 第一天就认清应急设施

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜、举着锥形瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing safety goggles holds up an Erlenmeyer flask and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到实验室安全第一课。

shots.scene: 人、样品、数据、实验室四个图标围成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Four icons arranged in a circle: a person, a sample tube, a data chart and a lab building. No people.
shots.narration: 安全护着人，也护着科研本身。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张空白签到表，匆匆签完名就往实验台走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student quickly signs a blank sign-in sheet and hurries toward a lab bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一天进实验室，签完名就想开干。

shots.scene: 阿杰对小研说：安全培训就是走个过场
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shrugs and talks casually to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 他觉得安全培训就是走个过场。

shots.scene: 小研拉住他，指向墙上的空白安全手册和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at a blank safety manual on the wall and an eyewash station.
shots.narration: 小研拉住他：先把安全这一课补上。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 安全不是打勾，是做科研的基础。

shots.scene: 空白检查表打勾的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank checklist with quick tick marks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全不是应付检查的打勾。

shots.scene: 安全像电脑操作系统一样托起实验、数据等图标
shots.prompt_en: A safety shield icon acting as a base platform supporting icons of experiments, data charts and samples on top. No people.
shots.narration: 它像操作系统，托起一切科研活动。

shots.scene: 安全、质量、数据三个圆环扣在一起
shots.prompt_en: Three interlocking rings with icons of a shield, a quality check mark and a data chart. No people.
shots.narration: 安全、质量、数据，三者分不开。

shots.scene: 架子上一本落灰的空白计划书
shots.prompt_en: A dusty blank plan book sitting on a high shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 原片案例：国外一所高校的实验室，

shots.scene: 自燃标识的试剂瓶和起火图标
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a flame-over-circle hazard pictogram next to a small fire icon. No people.
shots.narration: 研究人员放大使用遇空气自燃的试剂，

shots.scene: 化纤毛衣起火，阻燃服挂钩空着
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a synthetic sweater on fire next to an empty hook where a flame-resistant lab coat should hang. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂起火，她没穿阻燃服，不幸身亡。

shots.scene: 欣欣低头默哀
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot bows its head solemnly.
shots.narration: 实验室有书面计划，却没落到实处。

shots.scene: 防护、能力确认、结伴三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: protective gear, a competency check badge and two people working together. No people.
shots.narration: 防护、能力确认、结伴，一样都不能少。

shots.section_title: 每次实验押上的四样东西
shots.scene: 环形图分成四块：人、样品、数据、单位
shots.prompt_en: A ring chart divided into four equal parts with icons of a person, a sample tube, a data chart and an institution building. No people.
shots.narration: 每一次实验，都同时押上四样东西：
overlay: 每次实验押上的四样东西

shots.section_title: 每次实验押上的四样东西
shots.scene: 人员图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The person segment of the ring lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 人的生命健康，样品和数据的可靠，

shots.section_title: 每次实验押上的四样东西
shots.scene: 单位大楼图标亮起，连着资助和许可图标
shots.prompt_en: The institution segment lights up, linked to a funding icon and a permit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有单位继续做科研的资格。

shots.scene: 冰山图标：水面上小、水面下大
shots.prompt_en: An iceberg icon with a small visible tip above water and a huge hidden part below. No people.
shots.narration: 事故的代价，像冰山。

shots.scene: 水面上一个医疗十字，水面下调查、罚款、停工图标
shots.prompt_en: Above the water a medical cross icon; below the water icons of an investigation folder, a fine, a stop sign and a broken trophy. No people.
shots.narration: 医药费只是水面上的一角。

shots.scene: 多米诺骨牌依次倒下：经费、研究、声誉
shots.prompt_en: Dominoes falling one after another with icons of funding, research and reputation. No people.
shots.narration: 一次事故，可能毁掉多年的积累。

shots.section_title: 制度定目标，实验室定做法
shots.scene: 法规书指向一个目标靶心，实验室手册写出路线
shots.prompt_en: A law book icon pointing to a target bullseye, and a lab manual drawing a path to reach it. No people.
shots.narration: 制度规定要达到的安全目标，
overlay: 制度定目标，实验室定做法

shots.section_title: 制度定目标，实验室定做法
shots.scene: 老周带着小研、阿杰写实验室自己的安全手册
shots.prompt_en: The older man writes a blank lab safety manual together with the female graduate student and the young male student.
shots.narration: 具体怎么做，要每个实验室自己写清楚。

shots.section_title: 计划要活，负责人要在岗
shots.scene: 落灰的手册被红叉，翻新的手册打勾
shots.prompt_en: A dusty manual crossed out with a red X next to an updated manual with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 安全手册不能落灰，要随时更新。
overlay: 计划要活，负责人要在岗

shots.section_title: 计划要活，负责人要在岗
shots.scene: 新试剂加进清单，拆掉的设备划掉
shots.prompt_en: A blank list where new reagent icons are added and a removed instrument icon is crossed off. No people.
shots.narration: 新试剂写进去，拆掉的设备删掉。

shots.section_title: 计划要活，负责人要在岗
shots.scene: 小研戴着安全员袖标在实验室巡查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears a blank safety officer armband and walks through the lab checking benches.
shots.narration: 安全员要真在岗、真管事。

shots.section_title: 计划要活，负责人要在岗
shots.scene: 规程本和实验台上的操作对照，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A procedure book compared side by side with the actual bench setup, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 规程要和每天实际做的一致。

shots.section_title: 计划要活，负责人要在岗
shots.scene: 知道却不做的图标：手册在架上，人却违规
shots.prompt_en: A manual on a shelf while a person pictogram ignores it, with a red warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 写了不做，比没写更糟。

shots.section_title: 没有规定，也不能无视危险
shots.scene: 一瓶新型纳米材料，旁边是空白的规定书和问号
shots.prompt_en: A vial of a novel nanomaterial with sparkle icons beside an empty rule book and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 遇到新材料，还没有专门的规定，
overlay: 没有规定，也不能无视危险

shots.section_title: 没有规定，也不能无视危险
shots.scene: 小研查阅空白文献，看到毒性警示
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads blank research papers on a screen and spots a health hazard pictogram.
shots.narration: 只要资料显示有危害，

shots.section_title: 没有规定，也不能无视危险
shots.scene: 小研在手套箱里操作这瓶材料
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student handles the vial inside a glove box wearing gloves and goggles.
shots.narration: 就要主动采取防护措施。

shots.section_title: 安全和质量在实验台交汇
shots.scene: 一边是护着人的盾牌，一边是护着数据的图表
shots.prompt_en: Two cards: a shield protecting a worker icon, and a shield protecting a data chart and sample icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全护人，质量护数据和样品，
overlay: 安全和质量在实验台交汇

shots.section_title: 安全和质量在实验台交汇
shots.scene: 两条路在实验台汇合
shots.prompt_en: Two roads merging into one at a lab bench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 两者在实验台前汇合，不能各管各的。

shots.scene: 两人共用一个账号登录的图标，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two people sharing one login card at a computer, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 为了赶危险操作共用账号，记录找不到人。

shots.scene: 沾污的厚手套写出歪歪扭扭的字
shots.prompt_en: A thick contaminated glove writing messy scribbles in a blank notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 手套脏了、太笨，记录写得看不清。

shots.scene: 时钟和“回头再补”的记录本，时间对不上
shots.prompt_en: A clock beside a blank notebook with an arrow showing an entry written much later, timestamps mismatched. No people.
shots.narration: 嫌防护麻烦“回头再补”，时间就乱了。

shots.scene: 小研戴着合适的手套，当场清楚地记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing well-fitting gloves writes clear notes in a lab notebook right at the bench.
shots.narration: 安心操作，才能当场如实记录。

shots.scene: 天平和有毒粉末，旁边一个跳过的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A balance next to a container of toxic powder with a health hazard pictogram, and an arrow skipping past it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片案例：有人怕接触有毒粉末，

shots.scene: 编造的数字写进记录本，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: Made-up numbers being written into a blank notebook, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 竟编造称量数据，酿成造假问题。

shots.scene: 通风天平罩和防护用品打勾
shots.prompt_en: A ventilated balance enclosure with gloves and a respirator, marked with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 解决办法是做好防护，绝不是造假。

shots.scene: 一台密闭装置跌落，粉末扬起
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small containment unit falling with powder puffing out. No people.
shots.narration: 一次意外，既伤了人，也影响了实验。

shots.scene: 一次调查分出两份报告，再汇成一套整改
shots.prompt_en: One investigation icon splitting into two blank reports, then merging into one blank corrective action plan. No people.
shots.narration: 一起调查，分别记录，统一整改。

shots.scene: 两份互相矛盾的报告图标，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: Two reports with conflicting arrows, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 分头调查，结论容易打架。

shots.section_title: 安全改动也是实验变更
shots.scene: 小研把丁腈手套换成另一种手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student swaps nitrile gloves for a different type of chemical gloves.
shots.narration: 换了手套，可能影响实验结果。
overlay: 安全改动也是实验变更

shots.section_title: 安全改动也是实验变更
shots.scene: 操作从台面移进手套箱、通风橱换新型号的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a procedure moving from an open bench into a glove box, and an old fume hood replaced by a new one. No people.
shots.narration: 换了设备，样品所处的环境也变了。

shots.section_title: 安全改动也是实验变更
shots.scene: 老周审阅空白变更记录并签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews and signs a blank change record.
shots.narration: 再小的安全改动，也要评估、记录。

shots.scene: 脚手架图标和大脑图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two cards: a scaffolding icon and a brain icon. No people.
shots.narration: 制度和记录，是看得见的脚手架；

shots.scene: 深夜实验室里，阿杰独自也认真戴好护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Late at night in a quiet lab, the young male student puts on his goggles properly even though no one is around.
shots.narration: 文化，是没人看着时你怎么做。

shots.scene: 脚手架一松就塌的图标
shots.prompt_en: A scaffolding icon collapsing when a supervisor icon walks away. No people.
shots.narration: 只靠检查撑着，一松就垮。

shots.scene: 落灰的手册图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A dusty manual on a shelf with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 陷阱一：手册只为应付检查。

shots.scene: 随便指派的空白名牌图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank name badge drawn randomly from a hat, with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 陷阱二：安全员随便指派，没有实权。

shots.scene: 安全和质量两座孤岛
shots.prompt_en: Two separate islands, one with a shield and one with a data chart, with no bridge between them, red X. No people.
shots.narration: 陷阱三：安全和质量各管各的。

shots.scene: 未遂事件报告单被扔掉的图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank near-miss report form tossed into a trash bin, with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 陷阱四：没出事，就不报告险情。

shots.scene: 许多小三角堆成大三角，顶端一个红点
shots.prompt_en: A pyramid of many small near-miss triangles with one red incident dot at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 每起事故背后，都有许多次险情。

shots.scene: 周二下午，王老师带队检查，一切整齐
shots.prompt_en: On a sunny afternoon the safety administrator leads a tidy inspection and everything looks in order.
shots.narration: 检查那天一切都好，不代表真安全。

shots.scene: 周五深夜，窗外月亮，一个人疲惫地独自做实验的图标
shots.prompt_en: A late-night lab icon with a moon in the window and a tired lone person pictogram at a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 周五深夜，一个人又累又赶，

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头发问
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at the camera with a questioning expression.
shots.narration: 这时的实验室，还安全吗？

shots.scene: 实验室门口禁止饮食、禁止吸烟标志
shots.prompt_en: A no eating or drinking sign and a no smoking sign beside a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室不吃不喝，不吸烟。

shots.scene: 实验冰箱里放饮料的图标，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drink bottle inside a lab refrigerator with chemical samples, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 食品饮料不进实验室，不放实验冰箱。

shots.scene: 在实验室过夜睡觉的图标，被红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sleeping bag on a lab floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不在实验室休息过夜。

shots.scene: 通道畅通、台面整洁的实验室
shots.prompt_en: A tidy lab with clear walkways and an organized bench. No people.
shots.narration: 通道畅通，台面整洁。

shots.section_title: 第一天就认清应急设施
shots.scene: 小研带阿杰在实验室里走一圈，指向灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student around the lab and points at a fire extinguisher sign above an extinguisher.
shots.narration: 第一天，先认清应急设施在哪。
overlay: 第一天就认清应急设施

shots.section_title: 第一天就认清应急设施
shots.scene: 洗眼器、紧急喷淋、急救箱图标
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign, a safety shower sign and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器、紧急喷淋、急救箱，

shots.section_title: 第一天就认清应急设施
shots.scene: 安全出口标志和总电源开关
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign above a door next to a main power switch panel. No people.
shots.narration: 安全出口和总电源，都要心里有数。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现安全、质量、数据三个圆环
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three interlocking rings with a shield, a check mark and a data chart.
shots.narration: 安全是基础，和质量数据分不开。

shots.scene: 更新的手册和在岗的安全员图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an updated manual and a safety officer badge. No people.
shots.narration: 手册要活，安全员要在岗。

shots.scene: 如实记录和变更记录图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an honest lab notebook and a signed change record. No people.
shots.narration: 如实记录，改动先评估。

shots.scene: 深夜独自戴好护目镜的阿杰图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lone student wearing goggles properly at night. No people.
shots.narration: 没人看着时，也按规矩做。

shots.scene: 欣欣和大家在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the lab door together with the female graduate student and the young male student.
shots.narration: 安全第一课，从今天做起，下次见！
